The *Soceyya Sutta* ("Purity", Iti 66; It 3.17, PTS It 55) is a discourse in the *Itivuttaka*. The sutta expounds three kinds of purity or cleanliness (*soceyya*): bodily purity, verbal purity, and mental purity.
